name: manual_f88745
claim: Before trusting a peer's CI root-cause diagnosis, read the failing job's own log: two PRs were diagnosed as skip-budget failures when the real cause was a missing Core gate seam that made the runner refuse before the child reached its marker.

decisions.notes: Job logs showed gate.core_seam_unavailable and assert None == marker; only one of three PRs was a skip-budget failure.

rationale: Job logs showed gate.core_seam_unavailable and assert None == marker; only one of three PRs was a skip-budget failure.
